visual.description: A close-up of a man's face as he slowly shuts his eyes in a dark, moody room.

vo.en: Listen to this sound on loop. Ba. Ba. Ba. Sounds clear, right?

visual.description: Macro shot of a large black speaker subwoofer vibrating intensely from the bass.

vo.en: Now open your eyes and look at the mouth on screen.

visual.description: Extreme close-up of a man's mouth speaking directly into the camera.

vo.en: Wait, here is the creepy part. Did the sound just change to Fa?

visual.description: A digital glitch effect over a television screen showing static and distorted colors.

vo.en: Close them again and it instantly switches back. Your brain is overriding your ears.

visual.description: Animated blue neural pathways firing inside an abstract representation of a brain.

vo.en: Your eyes are literally hacking your hearing to make sense of the visual input.

visual.description: Light refracting through a glass prism, splitting into a spectrum of colors.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow's brain test and comment which word you heard first.

visual.description: A man's hand holding a smartphone and tapping the screen energetically.

vo.en: Your reality is just a guess, which is why you must...

visual.description: A fast-spinning hypnotic tunnel with swirling geometric patterns.
